title: Spider-Man
description: Inspired by the energy and movement of Spider-Man, this sketch focuses on dynamic anatomy, dramatic lighting, and expressive shading to capture a moment of action frozen in time.

title: Cosmic Stillness
description: A symbolic depiction of Lord Shiva in meditation, surrounded by flowing forms that represent balance, energy, and inner peace. Created using expressive pen strokes and layered line work.

title: Winter bloom
description: A cozy illustration capturing a quiet winter moment. The contrast between the bundled figure and the delicate bouquet symbolizes warmth, hope, and the simple beauty found in everyday moments.

title: Lost in the music
description: A portrait exploring quiet concentration through simple graphite shading. The headphones and side profile emphasize the immersive experience of music and moments of solitude.

title: Quiet Perch
description: A detailed study of a small bird resting on a branch. Fine pen strokes and careful texture work were used to bring out the softness of the feathers and the rugged surface of the bark.

title: Divine Strength
description: An intricate pen illustration of Goddess Durga with detailed ornamental patterns and traditional symbolism. Every line was carefully placed to celebrate strength, courage, and devotion.

title: Through the eyes
description: This portrait explores how emotion and expression can be conveyed through the smallest details.

title: Radha-Krishna
description: A graceful pen illustration inspired by Radha and Krishna, emphasizing flowing garments, expressive movement, and delicate floral elements to represent harmony and timeless devotion.

title: Grace of Ganesha
description: A detailed pen illustration of Lord Ganesha, capturing his divine presence through intricate patterns, calm expression, and balanced composition. The artwork combines traditional symbolism with modern linework to create a piece that feels both timeless and contemporary.
